title: Motor Claims Handler
company: XPERT RECRUITMENT SOLUTIONS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Motor Claims Handler
Newcastle under Lyme
Permanent
Monday Friday between 8.30 - 6pm (37.5 hours)
Hybrid working model.
£26,000 - £27,000 per annum + excellent benefits.

Are you an experienced Motor Claims Handler looking for a role with autonomy, variety, and the chance to deepen your knowledge of insurance risks?

We're recruiting on behalf of a respected insurance organisation that is expanding its specialist motor claims function with two new positions.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong motor claims experience who enjoys managing their own caseload while delivering exceptional customer service.

Details:

As a Motor Claims Handler, you will manage a diverse portfolio of motor claims, including first-party, third-party, and property damage. You will work independently while being supported by a wider team, ensuring each claim progresses smoothly and efficiently.

You'll liaise with customers, insurers, accident management companies, and other key stakeholders, taking ownership of both straightforward and more complex cases, including disputes, recoveries, and potential fraud referrals.

This role also offers the opportunity to broaden your expertise through training, qualifications, and exposure to specialist insurance claims.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing a varied caseload of motor claims
- Investigating liability, resolving disputes, and settling claims effectively
- Providing excellent customer service to clients and policyholders
- Identifying fraud indicators and recovery opportunities
- Managing complaints professionally and in line with guidelines
- Collaborating with internal and external partners
- Ensuring accurate, timely progression of all claims
- Completing mandatory compliance and internal training modules
- Potential involvement in credit hire and personal injury claims

What We're Looking For
Essential
- Previous experience in motor insurance claims handling
- Strong understanding of motor liability
- Experience in customer service and complaint resolution
- Knowledge of fraud, recoveries, and claims leakage
- Ability to manage a caseload independently
- Strong communication and organisational skills
- Good IT skills and the ability to work across multiple systems
- Ability to remain focused and productive during high-volume periods
- Ability to maintain confidentiality and adhere to data protection standards

Desirable
- Cert CII (or working towards it)
- UK driving licence
- Experience in process improvement

Working Environment & Development

This employer is committed to professional development, offering structured one-to-ones, career progression opportunities, and support toward industry qualifications (including Cert CII).

The team culture is customer-focused, positive, and collaborative - ideal for someone who enjoys contributing ideas, learning new skills, and working in a supportive environment.

Excellent benefits such as
- Death in service
- Enhanced maternity/paternity
- Excellent holidays including beach days!
- Health care plans
- Continuous development
- Discounts on social activities and many, many more.

If you're ready to take the next step in your career, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply now or get in touch with Jo Thompson - for more information. Feel free to contact me directly with any questions about the role or the recruitment process.

Xpert Recruitment Ltd is acting as an employment agency on behalf of our client. By applying, you agree to register with us and consent to us holding your personal details on file. Due to the high volume of applications, we will only contact candidates who have been shortlisted for the role. However, we may also reach out regarding other suitable vacancies that match your profile.

title: EL/PL Liability Claims Handler
description:

- To investigate all liability claims either from the desk or by instructing loss adjusters.
- To make the decision on liability.
- To negotiate settlement of the claim.
- To ensure compliance with all legal timescales and client SLA's.
- To build relationships with external clients and stakeholders.

title: Finance Assistant (Part-Time)
description:
Finance Assistant (Part-Time)

Location: Uttoxeter, hybrid - 3-4 days per week in office
Hours: 20-25 hours per week across 4-5 days (flexible working pattern available)
Salary: £13.45 per hour

Join a Supportive Finance Team

We're looking for an organised and detail-oriented Finance Assistant to support the day-to-day activities of a busy finance department. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with previous finance experience who is seeking a flexible part-time role within a collaborative and supportive working environment.

Playing an important role within the finance team, you'll assist with a variety of accounting and administrative tasks, helping to ensure financial processes run smoothly and efficiently.

The Opportunity

This is a varied position that combines transactional finance responsibilities with general administrative support. You'll be involved in both accounts payable and credit control activities, while also helping maintain accurate financial records and reporting information.

Key Responsibilities
- Support the smooth running of finance operations through a range of administrative and accounting tasks.
- Assist with supplier invoice processing, statement reconciliations and maintaining purchase ledger records.
- Help monitor customer accounts, track outstanding balances and support collection activities.
- Investigate and resolve supplier and customer queries in a timely and professional manner.
- Maintain accurate financial records and ensure information is kept up to date.
- Prepare spreadsheets, reports and supporting documentation for the finance team.
- Contribute to month-end activities and other finance projects as required.

We're interested in candidates who have:
- Experience within a Finance Assistant, Accounts Assistant or similar finance support role.
- Knowledge of both accounts payable and credit control processes.
- Strong Excel and general IT skills.
- Experience using finance or accounting systems.
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to work.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to build positive working relationships.
- A positive, team-oriented attitude with a willingness to support others.

Desirable:
- Previous experience using SAP Business One (SAP B1).

What's on Offer?
- Flexible part-time hours with the opportunity to agree a working pattern that suits both parties.
- Pension scheme and life assurance benefits.
- Healthcare cash plan and employee wellbeing support.
- Employee Assistance Programme.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.
- Generous annual leave entitlement, increasing with length of service.
- Friendly and supportive team culture.

Apply Today

If you're looking for a flexible finance role where you can utilise your accounting knowledge, contribute to a busy team and continue developing your skills, we'd love to hear from you. Submit your CV today.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
A highly successful company is looking for an accomplished Accounts Assistant to join its team. Please note this role is hybrid - you'll work from home 2 days per week with 3 days in the office.

You'll have a broad range of transactional finance duties. These will include processing purchase invoices and supplier payments, reviewing the purchase ledger, preparing monthly creditor analysis, reconciling company credit cards and processing foreign supplier payments. You'll also liaise with suppliers to resolve queries, support VAT returns and maintain accurate financial records.

Working as part of the finance team, you'll play an important role in providing accurate, timely and meaningful financial information to support business decision-making. Over time you will gain experience with management accounts, including journals, accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations, while supporting month-end and year-end close processes.

You'll also be involved in budgeting, forecasting, cash flow projections and variance analysis, helping to identify trends and investigate differences between actual and budgeted performance. This will involve working with colleagues across the organisation and explaining financial information clearly to non-finance stakeholders.

In order to be suitable for this role you must be a personable finance professional with great analytical skills. It is expected that you will be pursuing AAT, CIMA or ACCA qualifications and study support will be provided. You'll be comfortable working independently while also being a collaborative team player, with the confidence to build effective relationships across the wider organisation.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a motivated finance professional to broaden their experience, develop their management accounting skills and build a strong foundation for a successful long-term career in finance.

We are looking for Administrators to join our Integrated Care Coordination for Urgent Care service based in Hanley, Stoke-on-Trent to provide administration support and receive and action referrals. The primary aim of the Integrated Care Coordination (ICC) for Urgent Care is to be a single point of access to support patients to remain in their own home to prevent unnecessary admission to acute care and to facilitate collaborative Multidisciplinary Team (MDT) management for patients closer to home. You will play an integral part of the team by providing effective and efficient call handling, You should be highly skilled in administration and demonstrate keen self-management skills to enable them to provide an effective and efficient high-quality service. You will provide a varied range of administrative duties and act as a focal point for communication andcontribute to achieving key objectives and outcomes of the service. You will be required to cover the 7 day period, 365 days and therefore weekend and out of hours working is required. You will be dealing with referrals from GP's, WMAS, Health Care Professionals, Social Care Practitioners, and other professionals by telephone or other electronic formats and providing non-clinical advice, information and guidance to healthcare professionals and social care practitioners, to deal with all enquiries and communicate effectively on behalf of the Team. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (both written and verbal) are essential, as is an ability toorganiseandprioritise your workload and react quickly to changing situations. Strong IT skills are vital so you should evidence your experience of using data basis and Microsoft Outlook, Excel and Word on you application. As part of this role you will be expected to: Support with the preparation of all documentation, including agendas, and minuting meetings. To collect and input statistical information as required and ensure that reports are delivered within timescales. Making bookings and cancellations e.g. training places, rooms and interpreters. Receive, sort and distribute internal and external mail, ensuring that important and sensitive information is brought to an appropriate person's attention in a timely manner.
